residual.en: Residual moisture in the soil can affect the accuracy of laboratory measurements.
residual.zh: 土壤中残留的水分会影响实验室测量的准确性。

residual.en: The residual effects of the policy were still visible a decade later.
residual.zh: 10 年之后，这项政策的残余影响依然可见。

residual.en: Researchers measured residual levels of contamination in samples taken near the factory.
residual.zh: 研究人员在工厂附近采集的样本中测定了残留污染物的水平。

reciprocal.en: The two universities signed a reciprocal agreement allowing students to exchange credits.
reciprocal.zh: 两所大学签署了互惠协议，允许学生互认学分。

reciprocal.en: Reciprocal trust between departments significantly improved the pace of collaborative research.
reciprocal.zh: 院系之间的相互信任显著加快了合作研究的进度。

reciprocal.en: A reciprocal relationship between predator and prey shapes the stability of the whole ecosystem.
reciprocal.zh: 捕食者与猎物之间的相互关系塑造了整个生态系统的稳定性。

from scratch.en: The team rebuilt the entire pipeline from scratch after the data breach.
from scratch.zh: 数据泄露之后，团队从头重建了整条数据流程。

from scratch.en: She learned classical Chinese from scratch during her first year abroad.
from scratch.zh: 她在国外的第一年从零开始学习文言文。

from scratch.en: Writing the survey instrument from scratch gave researchers full control over wording.
from scratch.zh: 从头撰写问卷使研究者能够完全掌控措辞。

commence.en: The committee will commence its review of the proposal on Monday morning.
commence.zh: 委员会将于周一上午开始审查这份提案。

commence.en: Construction on the new laboratory will commence once the permits are issued.
commence.zh: 新实验室的建设将在许可证签发后动工。

commence.en: The lecture series commences with a short introduction to research ethics.
commence.zh: 该系列讲座以一场简短的研究伦理导论开始。

discipline.en: Years of discipline transformed his raw talent into professional mastery.
discipline.zh: 多年的自律将他的天赋打磨成了专业的精通。

discipline.en: Her academic discipline in medieval history shaped the questions she chose to ask.
discipline.zh: 她在中世纪历史这一学科上的专长，决定了她选择研究的问题。

discipline.en: Economic discipline kept inflation under control during the difficult second quarter.
discipline.zh: 经济上的纪律约束使通货膨胀在困难的第二季度保持在可控范围内。

akin.en: The symptoms of the two conditions are closely akin.
akin.zh: 这两种疾病的症状十分相近。

akin.en: Her approach to archival research is akin to that of medieval scholars.
akin.zh: 她研究档案的方法与中世纪学者颇为相似。

akin.en: Such a result would be akin to discovering an entirely new species.
akin.zh: 这样的结果无异于发现了一个全新的物种。

column.en: Enter the measurement in the final column of the spreadsheet.
column.zh: 请在电子表格的最后一列填入测量值。

column.en: She wrote a weekly column about urban planning in the newspaper.
column.zh: 她在报纸上撰写每周一篇的城市规划专栏。

column.en: The table contains five columns, one for each experimental condition.
column.zh: 该表格包含五列，分别对应每一种实验条件。

interpret.en: Historians continue to interpret the treaty very differently across regions.
interpret.zh: 历史学家们对这项条约的解读至今仍因地区而异。

interpret.en: The analyst interpreted the falling figures as evidence of renewed demand.
interpret.zh: 分析师把下降的数字解读为需求回暖的证据。

interpret.en: Participants were asked to interpret the ambiguous instructions in their own words.
interpret.zh: 参与者被要求用自己的话解释这些含糊的说明。

composite.en: The composite score combines accuracy, speed, and consistency into a single measure.
composite.zh: 综合得分把准确性、速度和稳定性合并为一项指标。

composite.en: Researchers developed a composite material from recycled fibres and bio-resin.
composite.zh: 研究人员用再生纤维和生物树脂开发出一种复合材料。

composite.en: Her writing style is composite, borrowing techniques from journalism and fiction.
composite.zh: 她的写作风格是综合式的，借鉴了新闻与小说的技巧。

analog.en: The maze task is considered a behavioral analog of everyday problem solving.
analog.zh: 该迷宫任务被视为日常问题解决行为的一种类比。

analog.en: The new protocol has no close analog in earlier research.
analog.zh: 新协议在早期研究中几乎没有相似的对应物。

analog.en: This historical case provides a useful analog for present policy debates.
analog.zh: 这个历史案例为当下的政策讨论提供了一个有用的参照。

tackle.en: The commission intends to tackle housing shortages through zoning reform.
tackle.zh: 委员会打算通过分区规划改革来解决住房短缺问题。

tackle.en: She tackled the difficult review with patience and clear thinking.
tackle.zh: 她以耐心和清晰的思路应对这场艰难的评审。

tackle.en: Governments must tackle climate risks before infrastructure budgets are exhausted.
tackle.zh: 政府必须在基础设施预算耗尽之前应对气候风险。

generic.en: The software offers a generic template that suits most research projects.
generic.zh: 该软件提供了一个通用模板，适用于大多数研究项目。

generic.en: Generic labels are less useful than specific descriptions in this catalog.
generic.zh: 在这份目录中，笼统的标签远不如具体的描述有用。

generic.en: Such generic guidance cannot replace careful judgment in each classroom.
generic.zh: 这类笼统的指导无法取代每个课堂中谨慎的判断。

leverage.en: Small firms can leverage social media to reach customers abroad.
leverage.zh: 小公司可以利用社交媒体触达海外客户。

leverage.en: The team leveraged existing datasets to shorten the development timeline.
leverage.zh: 团队借助已有的数据集来缩短开发周期。

leverage.en: Universities leverage partnerships with industry to fund applied research.
leverage.zh: 高校借助与产业界的合作关系来资助应用研究。

top-down.en: A top-down directive from headquarters delayed all regional decisions.
top-down.zh: 总部自上而下的指令延误了所有地区决策。

top-down.en: The agency abandoned its top-down model in favor of local discretion.
top-down.zh: 该机构放弃了自上而下的模式，转而赋予地方自主权。

top-down.en: Top-down reforms succeed only when frontline staff support them.
top-down.zh: 只有在一线员工的支持下，自上而下的改革才会成功。

bottom-up.en: A bottom-up approach lets researchers design the protocol around real needs.
bottom-up.zh: 自下而上的方法使研究者能够围绕实际需求设计研究方案。

bottom-up.en: The company grew through bottom-up innovation rather than top-down planning.
bottom-up.zh: 这家公司依靠自下而上的创新而非自上而下的规划成长起来。

bottom-up.en: Volunteers contributed a bottom-up effort that quickly spread across districts.
bottom-up.zh: 志愿者发起了一项自下而上的行动，很快在各区推广开来。

prohibitive.en: The cost of custom equipment proved prohibitive for most small laboratories.
prohibitive.zh: 定制设备的成本对大多数小型实验室而言高得难以负担。

prohibitive.en: Insurance premiums have become prohibitive for low-income households.
prohibitive.zh: 保险费用对低收入家庭来说已经高得难以承担。

prohibitive.en: Such an exclusive venue would carry prohibitive costs for a student conference.
prohibitive.zh: 这样一家高档场地对学生学术会议而言，费用高得令人望而却步。

provoke.en: The editorial provoked an angry response from readers across the country.
provoke.zh: 这篇社论激起了全国读者的愤怒回应。

provoke.en: Certain artificial sweeteners may provoke headaches in sensitive individuals.
provoke.zh: 某些人工甜味剂可能引起敏感人群的头痛。

provoke.en: The proposed tax reform was designed to provoke debate in parliament.
provoke.zh: 拟议中的税改旨在引发议会辩论。

parenthesis.en: Insert a parenthesis after the year to indicate the original source.
parenthesis.zh: 在年份后加一个括号以注明原始出处。

parenthesis.en: A misplaced parenthesis in the formula changed the entire result.
parenthesis.zh: 公式中一个位置放错的括号改变了整个结果。

parenthesis.en: She added a brief parenthesis explaining the unusual abbreviation.
parenthesis.zh: 她加了一处简短的括注来解释这个不常见的缩写。

implementation.en: The implementation of the new policy took longer than officials anticipated.
implementation.zh: 新政策的实施耗时比官员们预期的更长。

implementation.en: Poor implementation, not bad policy, caused the reform to fail.
implementation.zh: 导致改革失败的是执行不力，而非政策本身不好。

implementation.en: The team documented every stage of the implementation for future staff.
implementation.zh: 团队记录了实施的每一个环节，以供后来的员工参考。

by no means.en: The evidence is by no means sufficient to justify such a claim.
by no means.zh: 这些证据绝不足以支持这样的主张。

by no means.en: The experiment was by no means over when the funding ran out.
by no means.zh: 资金耗尽时，实验还远未结束。

by no means.en: He is by no means the only researcher to question these results.
by no means.zh: 对这些结果提出质疑的研究者绝不止他一人。

exceptional.en: She showed exceptional analytical skill during the final review.
exceptional.zh: 在终审中，她展现了卓越的分析能力。

exceptional.en: The laboratory recorded exceptional growth in demand for its specialist equipment.
exceptional.zh: 该实验室的专用设备需求出现了异乎寻常的增长。

exceptional.en: His exceptional performance earned him a place at the national institute.
exceptional.zh: 他出色的表现为他赢得国家研究所的一个名额。

permanently.en: The damaged section of the archive was permanently closed last spring.
permanently.zh: 档案馆受损的部分去年春天被永久关闭。

permanently.en: Salt concentrations in the sample changed permanently once the container opened.
permanently.zh: 容器一旦打开，样本中的盐浓度就发生了永久性的改变。

permanently.en: The hospital permanently adopted the new triage protocol in January.
permanently.zh: 该医院于一月正式永久采用了新的分诊流程。

witness.en: Two researchers witnessed the collision between the two experimental vehicles.
witness.zh: 两名研究员目击了两辆实验车辆相撞的过程。

witness.en: The committee invited colleagues who witnessed the events to testify.
witness.zh: 委员会邀请了目击事发经过的同事到场作证。

witness.en: Few historians have witnessed the slow decline of the region's dialects.
witness.zh: 很少有历史学家亲历过该地区方言的缓慢衰落。

reconcile.en: The mediator worked to reconcile the two departments over budget allocation.
reconcile.zh: 调解人努力就预算分配调解两个院系之间的分歧。

reconcile.en: She struggled to reconcile the experimental results with the published theory.
reconcile.zh: 她难以使实验结果与已发表的理论相吻合。

reconcile.en: The new director reconciled strict deadlines with the need for accuracy.
reconcile.zh: 新任主任兼顾了严格的截止日期与准确性要求。

apparatus.en: The laboratory purchased new glass apparatus for the chemistry experiments.
apparatus.zh: 实验室为化学实验购置了新的玻璃仪器。

apparatus.en: A simple apparatus of mirrors can demonstrate the principle clearly.
apparatus.zh: 一套简单的镜面装置就能清楚地演示这一原理。

apparatus.en: The apparatus was set up and tested within a single afternoon.
apparatus.zh: 这套仪器在一个下午便安装并测试完毕。

negligible.en: The difference between the two groups was statistically negligible in every trial.
negligible.zh: 在每次试验中，两组之间的差异在统计上都可以忽略不计。

negligible.en: The cost of repair proved negligible compared with replacing the equipment.
negligible.zh: 与更换设备相比，维修费用微不足道。

negligible.en: Such a negligible effect can safely be ignored when planning.
negligible.zh: 在制定计划时，这样微不足道的影响可以放心忽略。

rigorous.en: The team applied a rigorous statistical test to the collected data.
rigorous.zh: 团队对收集到的数据应用了严格的统计检验。

rigorous.en: His rigorous review of the literature changed the direction of the project.
rigorous.zh: 他对文献的缜密评述改变了项目的方向。

rigorous.en: Rigorous peer review remains the strongest safeguard against faulty claims.
rigorous.zh: 严谨的同行评审仍是防止错误结论的最有力保障。

therein.en: Further information regarding the method is contained therein.
therein.zh: 有关该方法的进一步信息已包含其中。

therein.en: The two systems differ mainly in the assumptions held therein.
therein.zh: 这两个系统的差异主要在于其中所持的假设。

therein.en: Researchers noted that the limitations discussed therein were unavoidable.
therein.zh: 研究人员指出，其中讨论的局限是无法避免的。

inevitably.en: Rising demand will inevitably place pressure on the production capacity.
inevitably.zh: 需求上升必然会给生产能力带来压力。

inevitably.en: Such shortcuts inevitably lead to errors in the final data.
inevitably.zh: 这样的捷径必然会导致最终数据出错。

inevitably.en: Any such expansion inevitably attracts attention from regulators.
inevitably.zh: 任何这样的扩张必然会引起监管部门的关注。

complimentary.en: The chairman offered complimentary remarks about the student's progress.
complimentary.zh: 主席对学生取得的进步给予了赞赏的评价。

complimentary.en: She received a complimentary review in the leading academic journal.
complimentary.zh: 她在一份顶尖学术期刊上得到了褒扬性的评述。

complimentary.en: A complimentary copy of the software was provided to every laboratory.
complimentary.zh: 每个实验室都获得了一份免费赠送的软件副本。

reconciliation.en: The reconciliation between the two departments took more than a year.
reconciliation.zh: 两个院系之间的和解花费了一年多时间。

reconciliation.en: Historians described the treaty as a remarkable reconciliation of conflicting interests.
reconciliation.zh: 历史学家称该条约是利益冲突的一次显著和解。

reconciliation.en: Financial reconciliation revealed several discrepancies in the reported figures.
reconciliation.zh: 财务对账揭示了报表数字中的若干不一致之处。

revelation.en: The release of the archive was a revelation to historians of the period.
revelation.zh: 档案的公开对研究该时期的历史学家来说是一个重大发现。

revelation.en: Her investigation produced a startling revelation about the missing funds.
revelation.zh: 她的调查就资金失踪一事揭露出了一个令人震惊的内幕。

revelation.en: The oral histories offered a revelation that reshaped our understanding.
revelation.zh: 这些口述历史揭示的真相重塑了我们的认识。

deduce.en: From the fragments we can deduce that the workshop was active.
deduce.zh: 从这些残片中我们可以推断出该作坊当时仍在运作。

deduce.en: Researchers deduced the original composition from the chemical residue.
deduce.zh: 研究人员从化学残留物推断出了原始成分。

deduce.en: It is reasonable to deduce that both teams shared the same supervisor.
deduce.zh: 有理由推断两个团队共用同一位导师。

recursive.en: The recursive definition calls the function again on a smaller input.
recursive.zh: 这个递归定义再次以更小的输入调用该函数。

recursive.en: Recursive models remain essential for describing hierarchical data structures.
recursive.zh: 递归模型对于描述层次化数据结构仍然不可或缺。

recursive.en: The programmer avoided recursive calls in the innermost loop for speed.
recursive.zh: 为提高速度，程序员在最内层循环中避免了递归调用。

iterative.en: An iterative process allows the design to improve gradually with each revision.
iterative.zh: 迭代过程使设计能够随着每次修订逐步改进。

iterative.en: The method combines an iterative search with a precise stopping condition.
iterative.zh: 该方法把迭代搜索与精确的停止条件结合起来。

iterative.en: Iterative testing revealed errors that a single final check had missed.
iterative.zh: 反复测试发现了仅靠最后一次检查会遗漏的错误。
